The Robocoders Brain

Brain is an electronics platform based on easy-to-use hardware and software.
Brain is designed to make electronics more accessible to artists, designers, hobbyists, and anyone interested in creating interactive objects or environments.
Brain is powered by Arduino nano and it includes a microcontroller, which is programmed using snap4arduino software.

In essence, this platform provides a way to build and program electronic components.

WHAT IT IS EXACTLY

The best way to explain what a “Brain”  is will be to start with what you can use it for.
Put simply, a “Brain”  is a tool for controlling electronics.
Think about a pencil. A pencil is a tool to help you write stuff.
You need to write something down so you could grab a pencil. Same idea with “Brain”. But  “Brain” is a tool for controlling electronics.
If you need to control some electronic stuff, hey, grab the Brain. But what do we mean by electronic stuff
Well let’s define two general groups of “electronics stuff”.
We’ve got inputs, and those would be electronic devices that gather information.
We also have outputs, those would be electronic devices that do things.

  • •.For inputs, you can think of all the types of sensors out there: temperature sensors, light sensors, touch sensors, flex sensors, humidity sensors, infrared sensors, distance sensors, to name a few.You can think of those sensors as input devices, and those types of sensors can be read by an Arduino board. 

  • •.Now outputs would be things like DC motors, stepper motors, servo motors, solenoids, LCD displays, LED indicator lights, speakers, and electrical stuff that have some type of action in the world. 

So Brain can be used to read inputs and control outputs. That’s kind of what Brain can do, but how does Brain work ?

Snap4arduio is a Block based coding system. Block-based coding utilizes a drag-and-drop learning environment, where programmers use coding instruction “blocks” to construct animated stories , games and code devices. It’s an entry-level activity, where you all can gain a foundation in computational thinking through visuals as opposed to coding that is based in text.

A Motor on Brain operates on 3 digital pins.

M1 port

D3  Enable

D2  Forward

D4  Backward

 

M2 port

D6  Enable

D7  Forward

D8  Backward

Points

      • •.A DC motor is rotary electrical motors that converts electrical energy into mechanical energy. 

      • •.To make the motor rotate in other direction without code, Interchange the motor wires on Motor Port.

In this lesson we  will learn Parallelism Coding by running both the Motor and LED simultaneously.

The term Parallelism refers to techniques to make multiple programs run at the same time.

Using  “When Flag Clicked” block  multiple times, refers to Parallelism Coding
